headline: Myspace lost every song uploaded in its first 12 years.
slides: Bands, bedroom producers and teenagers uploaded music to their Myspace pages.
An estimated 50 million songs, from about 14 million artists.
Around 2018 the old songs stopped playing. Users were told it was being fixed.
Myspace admitted the files were corrupted in a server migration. 'There is no way to recover the lost data.'
First demos, early bands, songs that only ever existed there.
Back up your stuff. Including this.
sources: Sources: Rolling Stone, NPR, Billboard, Engadget (March 2019)
